concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 1 T001 vs Phase 3 T015; Execution order line
concerns.text: T001 implements dual-mode (self + solute) extraction 'as mandated by the amended FR-001 (see T015)', but T015 — the producer of that amendment — is placed in Phase 3, AFTER T001 in the checklist body. This is a consumer-before-producer dependency: T001 consumes a spec state only T015 creates. The 'Execution order' line at the bottom does put T015 first (T015 → T001 → …), directly contradicting the checklist body order. Reconcile: move T015 to the top of Phase 1 (or mark T001 as blocked-on-T015) so the document order matches the declared execution order and the dependency is unambiguous.

T005 says 'Run the end-to-end data pipeline (T001 → T004)' but the declared execution order is T001 → T013 → T002 → T003 → T004; the range notation silently skips T013 (provenance JSON, which T005's verification also expects to exist). Update the range to '(T001 → T004, including T013)' or similar.

T009 aggregates 'model metrics (from T006/T014)' — correct — but also stability metrics from T008, which itself depends on the RF model from T006. The chain T006 → T008 → T009 is correctly ordered in the execution list; no violation, but T009's placement in Phase 2 after T008 is only implied by list position, not stated. Consider an explicit 'Depends on: T006, T007, T008, T014' note for machine-checkable ordering.
